```{css, echo=FALSE}
/* ---- status badges ---- */
.badge-pass    { background:#27ae60; color:#fff; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:4px; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold; }
.badge-fail    { background:#e74c3c; color:#fff; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:4px; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold; }
.badge-skipped { background:#95a5a6; color:#fff; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:4px; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold; }
.badge-warn    { background:#f39c12; color:#fff; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:4px; font-size:1.1em; font-weight:bold; }

/* ---- log styling ---- */
.log-block     { font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.82em; background:#1e1e1e; color:#d4d4d4;
                 padding:12px; border-radius:4px; max-height:360px; overflow-y:auto; }
.log-error     { color:#f44747; font-weight:bold; }
.log-warn      { color:#ce9178; }
.log-info      { color:#9cdcfe; }

/* ---- QA table highlight ---- */
.tbl-pass td   { background:#eafaf1; }
.tbl-fail td   { background:#fdedec; }
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# ── Helper: load a csv or return empty tibble ──────────────────────────────────
load_or_empty <- function(path, ...) {
  if (!is.null(path) && file.exists(path)) read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, ...)
  else tibble::tibble()
}

# ── Load QA artefacts from paths passed via params ────────────────────────────
qa_summary_raw  <- load_or_empty(params$qa_summary_csv)
qa_col_raw      <- load_or_empty(params$qa_column_report_csv)
qa_dup_raw      <- load_or_empty(params$qa_duplicate_csv)

# ── Load log file from path passed via params ──────────────────────────────────
if (!is.null(params$log_file) && file.exists(params$log_file)) {
  raw_log_lines <- readLines(params$log_file)
} else {
  raw_log_lines <- c()
}

# Classify each log line
classify_log <- function(lines) {
  lvl <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^ERROR|\\bERROR\\b", lines) ~ "ERROR",
    grepl("^WARN|\\bWARN\\b",   lines) ~ "WARN",
    TRUE                               ~ "INFO"
  )
  data.frame(level = lvl, text = lines, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
log_df <- classify_log(raw_log_lines)

n_errors <- sum(log_df$level == "ERROR")
n_warns  <- sum(log_df$level == "WARN")

# Overall status from QA
overall_status <- if (nrow(qa_summary_raw) == 0) "SKIPPED" else {
  statuses <- unique(qa_summary_raw$status)
  if ("FAIL" %in% statuses) "FAIL" else if ("PASS" %in% statuses) "PASS" else "SKIPPED"
}

status_badge_class <- switch(overall_status,
  PASS    = "badge-pass",
  FAIL    = "badge-fail",
  SKIPPED = "badge-skipped"
)
```

---

## Run summary

```{r run-summary-table}
tibble::tibble(
  Field = c("Timestamp", "Timepoint", "Log errors", "Log warnings", "QA status"),
  Value = c(
    params$run_timestamp,
    params$timepoint,
    as.character(n_errors),
    as.character(n_warns),
    overall_status
  )
) %>%
  kable(col.names = NULL) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(5, bold = TRUE,
    background = switch(overall_status, PASS = "#eafaf1", FAIL = "#fdedec", "#f5f5f5"))
```

**Overall QA status:** <span class="`r status_badge_class`">`r overall_status`</span>

---

## Pipeline log

```{r log-section, results='asis'}
# Show WARN and ERROR prominently first
flagged <- log_df[log_df$level %in% c("WARN", "ERROR"), ]

if (nrow(flagged) > 0) {
  cat("### ⚠ Warnings and errors\n\n")
  cat('<div class="log-block">\n')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(flagged))) {
    cls <- if (flagged$level[i] == "ERROR") "log-error" else "log-warn"
    cat(sprintf('<div class="%s">%s</div>\n', cls, htmltools::htmlEscape(flagged$text[i])))
  }
  cat('</div>\n\n')
} else {
  cat("### ✓ No warnings or errors\n\n")
}
```

<details>
<summary>Show full log (`r nrow(log_df)` lines)</summary>
```{r full-log, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="log-block">\n')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(log_df))) {
  cls <- switch(log_df$level[i], ERROR = "log-error", WARN = "log-warn", "log-info")
  cat(sprintf('<div class="%s">%s</div>\n', cls, htmltools::htmlEscape(log_df$text[i])))
}
cat('</div>\n')
```
</details>

## QA results

```{r qa-status-banner, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf('<p style="font-size:1.2em">Pipeline QA status: <span class="%s">%s</span></p>\n',
  status_badge_class, overall_status))
```

### Per-script summary

```{r qa-summary-table}
qa_summary_raw %>%
  mutate(
    `Columns compared`   = total_columns_compared,
    `Value mismatches`   = total_mismatches,
    `Duplicate keys (current)` = total_current_duplicate_keys,
    `Duplicate keys (baseline)` = total_baseline_duplicate_keys,
    `Key drift datasets` = datasets_with_duplicate_key_drift,
    Status = status
  ) %>%
  select(Script = report_prefix, Status,
         `Columns compared`, `Value mismatches`,
         `Duplicate keys (current)`, `Duplicate keys (baseline)`,
         `Key drift datasets`) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(qa_summary_raw$status == "PASS"), background = "#eafaf1") %>%
  row_spec(which(qa_summary_raw$status == "FAIL"), background = "#fdedec")
```

### Duplicate key detail

```{r qa-dup-table}
qa_dup_raw %>%
  mutate(
    `Key drift` = ifelse(duplicate_key_drift, "⚠ YES", "✓ No"),
    `Current duplicates` = ifelse(current_duplicate_key_count == 0, "None",
      paste0(current_duplicate_key_count, " (", current_duplicate_keys, ")")),
    `Baseline duplicates` = ifelse(baseline_duplicate_key_count == 0, "None",
      paste0(baseline_duplicate_key_count, " (see full report)"))
  ) %>%
  select(Dataset = dataset, `Key drift`, `Current duplicates`, `Baseline duplicates`) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(qa_dup_raw$duplicate_key_drift), background = "#fdedec")
```

### Column mismatch detail

```{r qa-col-table}
if (nrow(qa_col_raw[qa_col_raw$mismatches > 0, ]) > 0) {
  qa_col_raw[qa_col_raw$mismatches > 0, ] %>%
    select(Dataset = dataset, Column = column,
           `Total rows` = total_rows, Mismatches = mismatches,
           `% mismatch` = pct_mismatch) %>%
    kable() %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
    row_spec(seq_len(nrow(qa_col_raw[qa_col_raw$mismatches > 0, ])), background = "#fdedec")
} else {
  cat("✓ No column-level mismatches found across all compared datasets.")
}
```
